conceptText:
Rebirth of learning (Greek & Roman classics). Reformation began in 1517 (Luther). Elizabethan Age (1558-1603) gave Shakespeare, Spenser, Marlowe, Sidney. Metaphysical poets (John Donne) used 'conceit'. Key works: The Faerie Queene (Spenser), Hamlet (Shakespeare), Paradise Lost (Milton, 1667).

Punarjagran ka daur — yunan-Roman classics ka dobara janm; Reformation 1517 (Luther). Elizabethan Age (1558-1603) — Shakespeare, Spenser, Marlowe, Sidney. Metaphysical poets (John Donne) 'conceit' ke liye mashhoor. Key works: The Faerie Queene, Hamlet, Paradise Lost (1667). Milton = Puritan.

Monarchy restored in 1660 (Charles II) — hence the name. 'Comedy of Manners' flourished (Congreve, Wycherley). John Dryden was the greatest name (satire, heroic couplet). John Bunyan wrote The Pilgrim's Progress (1678).

1660 me Charles II ki wapasi (monarchy restored) — isliye 'Restoration'. Comedy of Manners ka daur. Dryden sabse bada naam (satire, heroic couplet). John Bunyan — The Pilgrim's Progress (1678).

Age of Reason / Augustan Age — emphasis on reason, order, wit. Alexander Pope: The Rape of the Lock, An Essay on Criticism. Jonathan Swift: Gulliver's Travels (1726). Addison & Steele: The Spectator. Samuel Johnson: A Dictionary of the English Language (1755).

Reason, order aur wit par zor (Age of Reason / Augustan Age). Pope — The Rape of the Lock. Swift — Gulliver's Travels (1726). Addison & Steele — The Spectator. Dr. Johnson — Dictionary (1755).

Began with Lyrical Ballads (1798) by Wordsworth & Coleridge. Themes: imagination, nature, emotion, common language. Poets: Wordsworth, Coleridge, Byron, Shelley, Keats. Essayists: Charles Lamb, Hazlitt, De Quincey. Novelists: Jane Austen, Sir Walter Scott.

1798 me Wordsworth & Coleridge ki Lyrical Ballads se shuruaat. Imagination, nature, emotion, aam bhasha par zor. Poets: Wordsworth, Coleridge, Byron, Shelley, Keats. Essayists: Charles Lamb, Hazlitt, De Quincey. Novelists: Jane Austen, Walter Scott.

Named after Queen Victoria (1837-1901). Moral earnestness, industrialisation, and religious doubt (Darwin's Origin of Species, 1859). Poets: Tennyson (In Memoriam), Browning, Matthew Arnold. Novelists: Dickens, Thackeray, George Eliot, Hardy, the Brontës.

Queen Victoria (1837-1901) ke naam par. Moral earnestness + industrialisation + doubt (Darwin 1859). Poets: Tennyson (In Memoriam), Browning, Arnold. Novelists: Dickens, Thackeray, George Eliot, Hardy, Brontë sisters.

Break with tradition; experiment with symbolism and stream of consciousness. T.S. Eliot: The Waste Land (1922). W.B. Yeats, James Joyce (Ulysses), Virginia Woolf, D.H. Lawrence, E.M. Forster.

Parampara se toot; symbolism aur stream of consciousness ke experiments. T.S. Eliot — The Waste Land (1922). Yeats, James Joyce (Ulysses), Virginia Woolf, D.H. Lawrence, E.M. Forster.

text: Lyrical Ballads (1798) kisne likhi?
exp: Lyrical Ballads (1798) se Romantic age ki shuruaat maani jaati hai.

text: The Faerie Queene ke writer kaun hain?
exp: The Faerie Queene — Edmund Spenser (Elizabethan age).

text: Restoration period ka sabse bada poet/critic?
exp: John Dryden — Restoration period ka mukhya naam.

text: Gulliver's Travels kisne likhi?
exp: Jonathan Swift — Gulliver's Travels (1726), satire ka master.

text: A Dictionary of the English Language (1755) kiski hai?
exp: Samuel (Dr.) Johnson — 1755 ki Dictionary.

text: 'Metaphysical Poetry' ka mukhya naam kaun hai?
exp: John Donne — metaphysical poetry aur 'conceit' ke liye mashhoor.

text: In Memoriam kisne likhi?
exp: Alfred Tennyson — In Memoriam (Victorian period).

text: The Waste Land (1922) kiski rachna hai?
exp: T.S. Eliot — The Waste Land (1922), modern poetry ka landmark.

text: Pride and Prejudice ki lekhika kaun hain?
exp: Jane Austen — Romantic period ki novelist.

text: Paradise Lost kisne likhi?
exp: John Milton — Paradise Lost (1667), Puritan.

text: 'Comedy of Manners' kis period se juda hai?
exp: Restoration period — Comedy of Manners.

text: Reformation ki shuruaat kis saal maani jaati hai?
exp: 1517 — Luther ke saath Reformation ki shuruaat.

text: 'Augustan Age' kis period ka doosra naam hai?
exp: Neo-classical period ko Augustan Age / Age of Reason bhi kehte hain.

text: Ulysses (novel) kisne likha?
exp: James Joyce — Ulysses (Modern period).

text: The Pilgrim's Progress kisne likha?
exp: John Bunyan — The Pilgrim's Progress (1678), Restoration.

text: Queen Victoria ka shasan-kaal kya tha?
exp: 1837-1901 — Victorian period ka naam inhi se.

text: Elizabethan Age ke dauran kaunse poet the?
exp: Shakespeare aur Spenser — Elizabethan Age (1558-1603).

text: The Rape of the Lock kisne likhi?
exp: Alexander Pope — The Rape of the Lock (Neo-classical).

text: Darwin ki 'Origin of Species' kis saal aayi?
exp: 1859 — Victorian doubt/faith ke tension ka karan.

text: Charles Lamb kaun the?
exp: Charles Lamb — Romantic period ke essayist.

text: Heroic couplet kis period ki khaas pehchaan hai?
exp: Restoration aur Neo-classical period me heroic couplet ka zor.

text: Stream of consciousness kis period ki technique hai?
exp: Modern period — stream of consciousness (Joyce, Woolf).

text: Matthew Arnold kaun the?
exp: Matthew Arnold — Victorian poet aur critic.

text: The Spectator kisne nikala?
exp: Addison & Steele — The Spectator (periodical essays).

text: P.B. Shelley kaunse period ke poet hain?
exp: Shelley — Romantic period ke poet.

text: George Eliot kaun hain?
exp: George Eliot — Victorian novelist.

text: W.B. Yeats kaunse period se juda hai?
exp: W.B. Yeats — Modern period.

text: Milton ko kis naam se jaana jaata hai?
exp: Milton — Puritan poet (Paradise Lost).

text: Jane Austen kis period ki novelist hain?
exp: Jane Austen — Romantic period ki novelist.

text: 'Conceit' kis type ki poetry ki khaas cheez hai?
exp: Metaphysical poetry — 'conceit' (achanak/naqli tulna).
